Class AbstractFileResolvingResource

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.core.io.AbstractResource
org.springframework.core.io.AbstractFileResolvingResource
All Implemented Interfaces:
InputStreamSource, Resource
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClassPathResource, ServletContextResource, UrlResource
public abstract class AbstractFileResolvingResource extends AbstractResource
Abstract base class for resources which resolve URLs into File references, such as UrlResource or ClassPathResource.

检测 URL 中的"file"协议以及 JBoss"vfs"协议，并相应解析文件系统引用。

Since:
3.0
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

      public boolean exists()
      描述从类复制：AbstractResource
      This implementation checks whether a File can be opened, falling back to whether an InputStream can be opened.

      这将同时涵盖目录和内容资源。

    • contentLength

      public long contentLength() throws IOException
      描述从类复制：AbstractResource
      This method reads the entire InputStream to determine the content length.

      对于 `InputStreamResource` 的自定义子类，我们强烈建议通过更优化的实现来重写此方法，例如检查文件长度，或者如果流只能读取一次则直接返回 -1。

      Specified by:
      `contentLength` 在接口 `Resource` 中
      Overrides:
      `contentLength` 在类 `AbstractResource` 中。
      Throws:
      IOException - 如果无法解析资源（在文件系统中或作为其他已知的物理资源类型）
      See Also:
      • InputStreamSource.getInputStream()

    • customizeConnection

      protected void customizeConnection(URLConnection con) throws IOException
      Customize the given URLConnection before fetching the resource.

      调用ResourceUtils.useCachesIfNecessary(URLConnection)，并在可能的情况下委托给customizeConnection(HttpURLConnection)。可在子类中重写此方法。

      Parameters:
      con - 要自定义的 URLConnection
      Throws:
      IOException - 如果从 URLConnection 方法抛出
